picks.rationale: 생성형 영상 구독의 '무제한' 마케팅이 추론 단가 앞에서 어떻게 무너지는지 보여주는 사례 — 툴 결제 전에 계산할 기준을 준다.
picks.excerpt: Artlist sold filmmakers a year of "unlimited" access to ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model for $500, then pulled the unlimited tier within days and swapped it for a modest credit allowance. CineD's breakdown shows the per-second inference economics made the offer impossible from day one — a warning about how gen-video pricing is being marketed to creators.

picks.rationale: AI 생성 푸티지 판별을 인제스트 단계에 넣을 수 있는 실물 마이크로서비스 — 뉴스룸·포스트 파이프라인에 바로 붙는 프로브넌스 체크다.
picks.excerpt: NVIDIA released a Synthetic Video Detector NIM microservice that flags AI-generated footage with up to 92% accuracy on uncompressed material, processing 1080p in 22ms on RTX systems. It is pitched at newsrooms and post teams that now need a provenance check inside the ingest pipeline.

picks.rationale: 에이전틱 AI가 MAM 안으로 들어와 자연어로 아카이브 검색과 포스트 워크플로를 굴린다 — 미디어 관리 업무의 조작 방식이 바뀐다.
picks.excerpt: Dalet launched cloud-native solution suites on its Flex platform with preconfigured workflows and agentic AI built in. The suites center on Dalia, a media-aware AI assistant that lets teams search video libraries, enrich metadata and trigger post/archive workflows through natural language.

picks.rationale: 뎁스맵·AI 로토·컨텐트 어웨어 필을 '기본 공정'으로 가르치는 커리큘럼 — VFX 아티스트가 아닌 감독·프로듀서용 학습 경로가 생겼다.
picks.excerpt: ActionVFX launched an online 'VFX for Filmmakers' course aimed at directors and producers who aren't VFX artists, built around After Effects and Photoshop. Its "Modern AI Integration" module teaches depth-map generation, AI-assisted rotoscoping, content-aware fill and LLM-assisted troubleshooting as standard craft steps.

picks.rationale: 영국 영상 업계가 규제·워크플로·스킬 갭 셋을 공식 의제로 올렸다 — 제작 인력 재교육이 어디로 향하는지 보여주는 지표.
picks.excerpt: The expanded 2026 AI Creative Summit lands at BFI Southbank on November 11 with three streams covering production workflows, rights and responsible AI, and the skills gap. The programme signals where UK film and TV craft training is being redirected as gen-AI tools move into normal post pipelines.
